confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from an RBA search result showing 0.6720 USD per AUD for 18 November 2026. I did not open the RBA page directly. Meal, coffee and beer anchors are based on Numbeo-derived figures found in search results (via Expatica and MyLifeElsewhere), converted at roughly 1.15 USD per EUR (my assumption). No cocktail or restaurant wine-by-the-glass prices were found. Cocktail is estimated at about 3x the beer price. The wine glass is estimated from Spanish restaurant norms. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not based on any search or live listings, and are the least certain. Summer (July) prices in Bilbao may be higher than average.
comparable_city_reasoning: Bilbao is one of Spain's pricier cities, with restaurant prices about 15% above the Spanish average. It is comparable to San Sebastián, though slightly cheaper, and to Madrid.
